title: Caffè Americano: Espresso Lengthened with Hot Water
summary: A strong, hot coffee made by pouring hot water over a single shot of espresso, optionally topped with steamed milk and sugar.

steps.title: Warm
steps.text: Warm the 180 ml mug with hot water and tip it out.

steps.title: Pull
steps.text: Pull a single shot of 30 ml espresso straight into the mug.

steps.title: Pour
steps.text: Slowly pour about 150 ml of just-boiled water over the espresso to fill the mug.

steps.title: Crema
steps.text: Pouring water onto espresso keeps some crema; for more crema, put the water in first and pull the shot onto it.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve at once, with a little steamed milk and a demerara sugar cube on the side for those who want them.

tips: Pouring the water over the espresso keeps some crema; for a thicker crema, put the water in the mug first and pull the shot on top.
Use a warmed mug to keep the drink hot for longer.
safety: A single shot contains roughly 60–75 mg of caffeine.
storage: Drink immediately whilst hot. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
